entries.title: redact the lockscreen copy of a locked app notification
entries.description: Notifications from a locked app no longer reveal their content on the lockscreen when Android is set to hide sensitive content.

entries.title: hide notification content while an app is locked
entries.description: Notifications posted by a locked app now show a placeholder instead of their title and text until the app is unlocked.

entries.title: resume apps with no startable activity after unlock
entries.description: Unlocking an app that has no launchable entry now opens it instead of returning to the home screen.

entries.title: show apps without a launcher activity in the app list
entries.description: Iconless packages like Shell now appear in the app list and stay visible on the dashboard while locked.

entries.title: add a per-app mode that locks only the selected activities
entries.description: An app's activity list can now be flipped so only the checked activities ask for the unlock prompt.

entries.title: skip redirect when a recents launch already has a posted auth
entries.description: Reopening a locked app from recents no longer stacks a second unlock prompt behind the one already on screen.

entries.title: validate token package before consuming a pending unlock
entries.description: Unlocking an app from recents no longer asks for a second authentication right after the first one succeeds.

entries.title: start the unlock prompt on first window focus
entries.description: The unlock prompt no longer cancels itself the moment a locked app launches, which sent you home before you could authenticate.
